Add a Pre-Triangulated GPU Polygon / MultiPolygon Layer

Source: R/map.R
add_polygons.Rd

Triangulates polygons in C++17 (earcut) and streams triangle index buffers and ring outlines directly to WebGL2 vertex buffers (zero JS earcut overhead).

Usage

add_polygons(
  map,
  data = NULL,
  fill_color = "#3b82f6",
  palette = "viridis",
  fill_opacity = 0.7,
  stroke = TRUE,
  line_color = "#e2e8f0",
  line_width = 1,
  extrude = NULL,
  popup = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  legend = TRUE,
  lng = NULL,
  lat = NULL,
  fill = TRUE,
  fillColor = NULL,
  fillOpacity = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  weight = NULL,
  opacity = NULL,
  highlightOptions = NULL,
  labelOptions = NULL,
  dashArray = NULL,
  smoothFactor = NULL,
  layerId = NULL
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

data

An sf, sfc, or data.frame object.

fill_color

Fill color aesthetic (color string, formula ~col, or column name).

palette

Color palette name ("viridis", "plasma", "magma", "turbo", "Spectral", etc.).

fill_opacity

Polygon fill opacity (0 to 1).

stroke

Logical; whether to draw a crisp anti-aliased stroke around each point.

line_color

Border line color string (default "#ffffff").

line_width

Border line width in pixels (default 1.0).

extrude

Optional 3D extrusion height aesthetic (formula ~height, column name, or numeric).

popup

Optional formula (~name), column name, or character vector for click/hover tooltips.

label

Alias for popup.

id

Layer ID string.

group

Layer group name shown in the interactive layer switcher.

legend

Logical; whether to automatically add a legend when color is mapped to data.

lng, lat

Optional coordinate vectors or formulas (~long, ~lat) when data is a data.frame or matrix (such as quakes[chull(...), ]).

fill

Logical; whether to fill the interior of the polygon (default TRUE). When FALSE, renders an unfilled outline ring.

fillColor, fillOpacity, color, weight, opacity, highlightOptions, labelOptions, dashArray, smoothFactor, layerId

Optional leaflet::addPolygons() compatibility parameters.
